tagline: Surface Salesforce action items in Todoist and log work back automatically
metaTitle: Todoist + Salesforce Integration: Deal Stages to Tasks
metaDescription: Create Todoist tasks from Salesforce opportunity stages and log completions as activities. GAIA flags stalled deals. See the setup steps.
intro:
Salesforce is the system of record for enterprise sales teams, but its task management interface is rarely where reps do their best planning. Most high-performing account executives maintain a parallel personal task list — often in Todoist — to actually run their day. The problem is that keeping two systems in sync requires manual updates that eat into selling time and almost inevitably lead to one system falling behind.

GAIA automates the bridge between the two so your personal planner and your CRM tell the same story. When an opportunity reaches a critical stage or a task is due, GAIA creates the corresponding Todoist item so it appears in your daily plan. When you complete that task, GAIA logs the activity back in Salesforce against the right opportunity, contact, or account so the CRM record stays current without you ever opening it just to log a note.

This integration suits enterprise account executives who manage complex deals in the CRM but plan their days in their personal task list, and sales operations teams who want activity compliance across the organization without forcing reps to change their personal workflow.

useCases.title: Create Todoist tasks from Salesforce opportunity stages
useCases.description: When an opportunity moves to Proposal or Negotiation, GAIA creates a task with the follow-up action, contact name, and deal value so nothing gets missed in a large pipeline.

useCases.title: Log task completions as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: Completing a sales-related task triggers GAIA to log a completed activity on the linked record, maintaining CRM hygiene without manual data entry.

useCases.title: Stalled opportunity alerts
useCases.description: GAIA detects opportunities with no activity updates in a configurable window and creates urgent tasks to re-engage before the opportunity goes cold.

useCases.title: Contract renewal reminders
useCases.description: GAIA reads renewal dates from the CRM and creates tasks 90, 60, and 30 days ahead, ensuring renewal conversations start early enough to protect revenue.

useCases.title: Post-meeting follow-up workflow
useCases.description: After a meeting is logged in the CRM, GAIA creates a set of standard follow-up tasks, send recap email, update opportunity stage, schedule next call, so every meeting leads to clear next actions.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Salesforce to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate both accounts in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses Connected App OAuth on the Salesforce side so your admin can approve the connection with the right permission set.
Map stages, record types, and field changes to task templates. Specify due date offsets, priority levels, and which project receives each type of task.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps CRM and personal planner in sync
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the CRM for trigger conditions and the planner for task completions, creating items and logging activities automatically so both stay accurate.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require a Salesforce admin to set up?
faqs.answer: For individual rep use, a standard user with API access is sufficient. For org-wide deployment, an admin may need to approve the Connected App.

faqs.question: Which objects does GAIA interact with?
faqs.answer: GAIA works with Opportunities, Contacts, Accounts, Tasks, and Events. Activity logging creates Task records against the relevant Opportunity or Contact.

faqs.question: Can I use this with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud?
faqs.answer: Yes. Objects from both are supported, so account managers and support reps can each configure workflows suited to their use case.

faqs.question: Will Todoist task notes be preserved in the CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes. Notes added to a task are included in the activity description when GAIA logs the completed task, preserving context in the CRM.
